explanation: This tests normal acceleration in vector-function calculus, absent from the supplied Linear Algebra topics, so it is prerequisite. Differentiating gives a(t)=⟨0,-sin(t),cos(t)⟩. At t=0, v=⟨1,1,0⟩ and a=⟨0,0,1⟩. Since v·a=0, acceleration is entirely normal, with magnitude 1 m/s². Thus option d is correct.
